title: Coexistence from First Principles
description: A layered reconstruction of Madhyasth Darshan's ontological core, activity-duration, order-relative stability, and knowledge-order cycles, with explicit boundaries between textual doctrine, formal organization, mathematical analogy, and open posits

title: A State Dynamic Model of Coexistence
description: This paper reconstructs Madhyasth Darshan's account of coexistence as one state-dynamic model: state-complete Omnipresence and saturated units, the effort–motion–result triad and the four aspects of every unit, compositional plateaus and coupled orders, constitutional completeness, and the knowledge-order refinement of jeevan toward activity and conduct completeness. The formal apparatus is collected in appendices; the body presents the model in prose and diagrams.
